svg.title: A Lightweight Vision App
svg.desc: A shelf photo taken at closing time is read and base64-encoded as a data URL. One request carries an input_text instruction, count empty slots and reply as JSON, and an input_image part. A vision-capable deployment, with no custom training, returns JSON such as empty_slots 3. Code validates the JSON: valid and expected results generate the restock list; unexpected results go to a person. Image Analysis 4.0 is deprecated, retiring 25 September 2028, Custom Vision is retiring and Face emotion and gender recognition are retired, so use multimodal models or Content Understanding.
svg.text: Photo plus instruction in one request, a fixed reply format, validation in code, a person for surprises.
input_text: "Count empty slots. Reply as JSON" +
2028), Custom Vision, Face emotion and gender.
